name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 28, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Michael Vincent, Member of the Baha’i Faith
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Letter of Appreciation to Artist Lori Escalera for painting the Vista View North mural and other contributions to the art community of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Letters of Appreciation to Waterpark Manager Natalie Livingston and Assistant Waterpark Manager Tiffany Luther for promoting the safety of visitors and employees at the Wave Waterpark. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the check register.
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
Recommended Action:
Waive reading of ordinances on the agenda.
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
Approve the following Minutes:
August 7, 2007, Workshop Meeting (CC)
August 14, 2007, Regular Meeting (CC/BSD/CDC)
August 15, 2007, Special Joint Dinner Meeting (CC)
C4.
Application for an Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) License for Platinum Gift, Inc., 1487 Poinsettia Avenue, Suite 129 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Protest the application on conditions and authorize the Assistant City Manager to withdraw the protest once the applicant agrees to the recommended conditions.
C5.
Application for an Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) License for Los Amigos Restaurant, 1350 E. Vista Way, Suite 8-9 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Protest the application on conditions and authorize the Assistant City Manager to withdraw the protest once the applicant agrees to the recommended conditions.
C6.
Planning Commission Stipend (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , setting the stipend of the Planning Commission.
C7.
Waiver Request for Grading Inspection and Plan Check Fees (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , waiving the Grading Inspection and Grading Plan Check fees for the Alta Vista Gardens Jungle Lake project.
C8.
Safer Grant Application (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the online submission of a Department of Homeland Security Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response grant application to fund fifteen new firefighting personnel.
C9.
Federal Legislative Lobbyist Agreement (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the agreement with Carpi Clay & Smith, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C10.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending June 30, 2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the report.
C11.
Prohibition of Sale and Distribution of Novelty Lighters (CC)
Recommended Action:
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Vista, California, Adding Chapter 8.74 to the Vista Municipal Code to Prohibit the Retail Sale or Distribution of Novelty Lighters."
C12.
Sewer Rate and Connection Fee Study Agreement with Red Oak Consulting (CC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the first amendment to the agreement for financial consulting services, expanding the scope of the contract to include a connection fee study, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007- , authorizing the expenditure of funds to conduct a sewer rate and connection fee study.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Establishing Design Build List (CC)
Recommended Action:
Approve the list of design build firms included as Exhibit 1.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
San Clemente Avenue Reimbursement District (CC)
Recommended Action:
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony and take the following actions:
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a declaration of intention for a Reimbursement District for San Clemente Avenue;
2.
Set October 9, 2007, as the date for a public hearing to establish a Reimbursement District for San Clemente Avenue; and
3.
Provide direction related to in-lieu fees collected prior to the 2002 public hearing on the proposed Reimbursement District.
PH2.
Pheasant Hills Specific Plan (CC)
Recommended Action:
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the Mitigated Negative Declaration, General Plan Amendment, Zone Change, new Specific Plan, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Subdivision Map; and take the following actions:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration and the Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation on a 3.3.acre site from Medium Density Residential (MD) to Specific Plan Area (SPA);
3.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from R-1-B to Specific Plan Implementation (SPI) on a 3.3 Acre Site at 420 Lado de Loma Drive and Adoption of the Pheasant Hills Specific Plan"; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Tentative Subdivision Map and Site Development Plan for fifteen single family residential lots and one private street lot on a 3.3 acre site at 420 Lado de Loma Drive.
PH3.
Review and Approval Process for City Projects (CC)
Recommended Action:
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony and adopt the following:
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapters 18.04 and 18.12 Relating to City Projects."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
